content.text: [Benamor](/courses/benamor) is a short, scenic course just outside Tavira, laid out from Sir Henry Cotton's plans and opened in 2000. It plays 5,456 metres, par 71, between centuries-old olive, cork, carob, fig and almond trees, with mountain views to the north and the Atlantic to the south.
Benamor has no hotel of its own, but Tavira and Cabanas de Tavira are only 6 to 13 minutes away, so there is plenty of choice. Here are the best **hotels near Benamor golf**, nearest first.
Map of hotels near Benamor golf
The black pin is the course (tap it to see course details). The blue pins are the hotels in this guide; tap one to check prices and availability.
How we chose these hotels

We include a hotel if it is rated at least 8 out of 10 on Booking.com, or at least 7.8 if it offers specific golf services. Every hotel here is within about 13 minutes of the course. Drive times are calculated by road to the course, not in a straight line.

Prices are the lowest nightly rates we found in November 2026, either on the hotel's own website or where two sources agreed, so treat them as a guide. Where we couldn't confirm a price, we leave it out: use the link to check rates for your dates.
Closest to the course

content.name: OZADI Tavira Hotel
content.text: A four-star hotel with 76 rooms and suites on the edge of Tavira, rated **9.0 on Booking.com** from more than 3,700 reviews, from about €77 a night in November. It has two pools, a bistro, a massage room, a padel court and free parking. About 6 minutes from Benamor.

content.name: Pedras da Rainha
content.text: Self-catering villas and apartments that list Benamor, 1.8 km away, among their facilities. Rated **8.4 on Booking.com**, from about €75 a night in November, with a pool, tennis, padel and lawn bowls, and free transport to Cabanas beach. About 6 minutes from Benamor.

content.name: Conversas de Alpendre
content.text: A rural-tourism property near Vila Nova de Cacela, rated **9.3 on Booking.com**, from about €179 a night in November, with an outdoor pool, a restaurant and free parking. Breakfast starts at 8.30am. It sits almost exactly between Benamor and the Quinta da Ria courses. About 9 minutes from Benamor.
Golf-friendly hotels around Tavira

content.name: AP Maria Nova Lounge
content.text: An adults-friendly hotel a five-minute walk from Tavira's old town, rated **8.5 on Booking.com**, with a rooftop restaurant and bar and a spa with a heated indoor pool. The AP group recommends it for golf holidays: its golf desk books green fees, club hire, transfers and lessons, and it hosts a golf tournament in January 2027 with rounds at Benamor and Quinta da Ria. About 11 minutes from Benamor.
perks: Golf desk: green fees, club hire, lessons

content.name: AP Cabanas Beach & Nature
content.text: A large adults-friendly hotel (recommended for guests aged 14 and over) in Cabanas de Tavira, rated **8.8 on Booking.com** from almost 3,900 reviews, with bed and breakfast or all-inclusive stays. The AP group's golf desk books green fees, club hire, transfers and lessons. About 10 minutes from Benamor.
perks: Golf desk: green fees, club hire, lessons

content.name: Robinson Quinta da Ria
content.text: An all-inclusive Robinson club set between the Quinta da Ria and Quinta de Cima courses, with the first tee of both and a driving range inside the resort. It scores **8.4 on Booking.com**. Robinson sells green-fee packages, the golf desk hires out clubs and there are lockable bag lockers for a fee; meals are buffets, with two restaurants and two bars. About 13 minutes from Benamor.
perks: First tees of both courses on the resort

content.text: Hotels in Tavira

content.name: Quinta da Capelinha
content.text: A farm stay near Tavira, rated **9.1 on Booking.com**, from about €57 a night in November with breakfast, with an outdoor pool and free parking. About 10 minutes from Benamor.

content.name: Vila Galé Tavira
content.text: A four-star hotel near Tavira's old town, rated **8.4 on Booking.com** from more than 3,000 reviews, with a spa and two pools. Breakfast starts at 7am, which suits early tee times. About 12 minutes from Benamor.

content.name: Hotel Don Rodrigues
content.text: A small hotel rated **8.8 on Booking.com**, from €65 a night with breakfast on its own website, with an outdoor pool and free parking. Breakfast is served from 8am with homemade cakes. About 12 minutes from Benamor.

content.name: Pousada Convento Tavira
content.text: A Pousada in a former 16th-century convent in Tavira, rated **9.0 on Booking.com**, from €131 a night on its own website, with an outdoor pool, a restaurant and free parking. Breakfast runs from 8am to 11am. About 13 minutes from Benamor.
Benamor green fees and what to know before you play

Benamor's internet rates are **€66** in low season (December, January and June to August), €95 in mid-season and €103 in high season, with afternoon tee times in low season for €59. See [Benamor green fees](/courses/benamor/green-fees). You need a handicap certificate, with a maximum of 28 for men and 36 for ladies. Buggies cost €48.
Tips for golfers staying near Benamor
**Benamor or Quinta da Ria?** The two are only 11 minutes apart. Read [Benamor vs Quinta da Ria](/guide/benamor-vs-quinta-da-ria-which-tavira-golf-course-should-you-play).

**Getting there.** Benamor is about 50 km from Faro Airport by road. A [pre-booked transfer](https://gettransfer.tpo.li/9bs77WsA) to Tavira is easy, though a car makes it simpler to reach the other eastern courses.
**More golf nearby.** Quinta da Ria and Quinta de Cima are about 11 minutes away and Monte Rei about 28. See our [Tavira golf courses page](/tavira/golf-courses).
Frequently asked questions
Is there a hotel at Benamor golf?
No. The closest well-rated places are OZADI Tavira Hotel and the Pedras da Rainha villas, both about 6 minutes away.
Which Tavira hotels offer golf services?
AP Maria Nova Lounge and AP Cabanas Beach & Nature share a golf desk that books green fees, club hire, transfers and lessons, and Robinson Quinta da Ria has two courses on its doorstep.
Playing several courses? Find the best base for your trip

If Benamor is just one stop on your golf trip, try **Find Your Base** on the [Algarve Golf Map](/). Pick the courses you want to play and it shows you the area that sits closest to all of them, along with well-rated hotels nearby.
